info.title: SeoSeo API
info.description: Free, open-source SEO platform API. Authenticate with a session cookie (web app) or `Authorization: Bearer seo_…` API key.

post.summary: Create a key bound to the active workspace. The secret is returned once.

get.summary: The issue catalog: ids, severities, explanations and fixes.

post.summary: Create an account (the first account becomes the instance admin) and sign in.

get.summary: Whether sign-up is open and whether the instance still needs its first (admin) account.
Status of the domain authority data (SeoSeo Rank from the Common Crawl web graph).

post.summary:
Import the top domains of the latest Common Crawl web graph (owners). Runs in the
background; follow it with `GET /jobs/{id}`.

get.summary: SeoSeo Rank of a domain.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain or URL, e.g. `example.com`.

get.summary: Instance metadata used by the web app before sign-in.
Public: details of an open invitation (for the invite landing page).

post.summary: Accept an invitation as the signed-in user and switch to that workspace.

get.summary: Recent jobs of the active workspace, newest first.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: queued | running | completed | failed | cancelled

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Default 50, max 200.

post.summary: Enqueue a no-op job to check the worker is running.

get.summary: Job counts by status for the last 7 days.
The signed-in user, active workspace and role.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: List archived projects instead of active ones.

delete.summary: Permanently delete an archived project and all its data.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: prompts (default) or answers. Brand filters match literal terms in saved answers.

post.summary:
Start a crawl of the project's website. Runs in the background; follow progress via
`GET …/audits/{audit_id}` or the `…/events` stream.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: changes (default) | all | changed | unchanged | only_in_baseline | only_in_current

get.summary:
Server-sent events: an `audit` event with the audit JSON every second while it runs,
then one final event and the stream closes.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: First pages alphabetically to visualize (10–500; default 200).

get.summary: All issues as CSV (url, issue, severity, title, details).
Issue types found, with the number of affected pages.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring of URL or title.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: 2xx | 3xx | 4xx | 5xx | error

parameters.name: issue_type
parameters.description: Only pages with this issue type.

get.summary: One crawled page with its issues, outgoing links and inlinks.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: all (default), live (includes new), new, lost

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain or URL; defaults to the project's website. Subdomains roll up to the registrable domain.

get.summary: Read-only page-planning suggestions from this project's cached top-ten search results.

parameters.name: min_shared
parameters.description: Minimum shared top-ten URLs for every pair in a group (2–10; default 3).

post.summary:
Expand a seed keyword into ideas with popularity, intent, and (for the top ideas)
difficulty and SERP features. Runs in the background; poll the research until its status
is `completed`. Metrics that cannot be determined are `null`, never 0.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring of the keyword.

parameters.name: intent
parameters.description: informational | commercial | transactional | navigational

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only ideas from this source, e.g. `suggest_google`, `related`.

parameters.name: questions
parameters.description: Only question-style ideas.

parameters.name: max_kd
parameters.description: Only ideas with a known difficulty at or below this.

parameters.name: min_volume
parameters.description: Only ideas with a known volume estimate at or above this.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: popularity (default) | keyword | est_volume | kd | word_count

get.summary: All ideas of a research as CSV. Empty cells mean "unknown".

post.summary: Track where a domain ranks for a set of keywords in one market.

get.summary:
The tracker with the latest position of every keyword (plus previous and best) and its
recent runs. A null `position` with a `checked_at` means "not in the first `depth`
results"; a null `checked_at` means "never checked".

Request budget of a run: provider requests per run and per month. SeoSeo has no credits;
this only tells you what the configured provider will be asked to do.
Position history of one keyword, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most recent checks to return (default 90, max 365).

post.summary: Remove keywords and their position history.

Check positions now (all keywords or a subset). Runs in the background: poll the tracker
or `GET /jobs/{job_id}`. Every keyword costs one request to the search results provider.

get.summary: Per-run summary (ranking keywords, top 3, top 10, average position), oldest first.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: created_at (default) | keyword | popularity | est_volume | kd | word_count

post.summary: Save ideas of a research (`research_id` + `idea_ids`) or keywords typed by hand.

get.summary: Saved keywords as CSV. Empty cells mean "unknown".
Tags in use on this project's saved keywords.

post.summary:
Results page of a keyword with each domain's authority, SERP features, related searches,
difficulty and intent. Cached pages are reused for 7 days unless `refresh` is set.

get.summary:
Data providers with their status for the active workspace. Free providers are on by
default; API keys are never returned.

put.summary: Switch a provider on or off, or set/remove its API key (admins).

post.summary: Make one small live request to check a provider works (admins).

Invite someone by email. Returns a one-time token for the link `/invite/{token}`;
share it with them (email delivery arrives with SMTP support).

delete.summary: Remove a member (admins), or leave the workspace (yourself). Owners cannot be removed.

share_of_voice_pct.description: Share of all tracked brand-answer matches; undefined when no tracked term matched.

brand_mentions.description: Null when no brand term was requested.

prefix.description: First characters of the key, for recognising it in lists.

phase.description: queued | probe | discover | crawl | analyze | done

total_domains.description: Domains in the whole graph (the worst possible rank).

oneOf.description: Running or queued import job, if any (poll `/jobs/{id}` for progress).
Last finished import; null when nothing was imported yet.

nofollow.description: Null means the imported sample did not specify the link relation.

comparison_id.description: Previous import for this dataset/domain. Kept as provenance even if it is deleted.

referring_domains.description: Aggregates use current sample membership (live + new), not lost rows; at most 100 each.

spam_score.description: Unknown until an independently supported scoring source is available.

urls.description: Distinct HTTP(S) URLs in positions 1–10, with fragments removed.

domain.description: Root domain, e.g. `example.com`. URLs are accepted and reduced to the host.
Domain to track; defaults to the project's website. Subdomains count as the domain.

hour_utc.description: Hour of day in UTC for scheduled runs (default 6).

weekday.description: ISO weekday for weekly runs, 1 = Monday (default 1).

secret.description: The full secret. Shown once; store it now.

token.description: Secret token for the invite link (`/invite/{token}`). Shown once.

age_days.description: Whole days since the registry's registration event, computed at read time. Unknown = null.

domain.description: Defaults to the project's website; subdomains normalize to the registrable name.

authority_loaded.description: False until ranks were imported; then a null `sr` means "weaker than every imported domain".

domain.description: Registrable domain that was looked up.

harmonic_rank.description: Position by harmonic centrality in the Common Crawl domain graph.

sr.description: SeoSeo Rank 0–100; null when the domain is outside the imported list.

estimated_monthly_traffic.description: Rounded observed-sample clicks only when every matched keyword has eligible exact rank/volume evidence; never total domain traffic.

keyword_gaps.description: Requested-domain keywords where the project's domain was not observed, capped at 100.

keywords.description: Paginated best results per keyword; totals/distribution use the full bounded sample.

limit.description: How many top domains to import (1,000–20,000,000; default 1,000,000 ≈ 30 MB download).

complete_sample.description: Must be true: the provided rows replace the entire sample for this dataset.

dataset.description: Stable lowercase dataset key, e.g. gsc-export. Diffs never cross datasets.

expected_domain.description: Exact current project website; prevents a stale import after a website change.

links.description: At most 1000 distinct external source/target URL pairs, within the API's 2 MiB body cap.

followed.description: True if at least one observed link for this pair does not carry nofollow.

suggestions.description: At most three sources per target, fifty suggestions overall. Manual review required.

incoming_sources.description: Unique other source pages across the full stored audit, including nofollow.

outgoing_targets.description: Unique non-self destinations across the full stored audit.

suggestion_eligible.description: Set by the domain service after checking status, canonicals and crawl scope.

representative.description: Stable alphabetical representative; not a volume or business-priority recommendation.

ungrouped.description: Eligible keywords that could not join a group; not proof of distinct intent.

est_volume.description: Estimated monthly searches; null when there is no basis for an estimate.

kd.description: Keyword difficulty 0–100; null until a SERP was analysed.

popularity.description: Relative popularity within this research (0–100). Not a search volume.

serp_features.description: Null until a SERP was analysed.

sources.description: Where the idea came from, e.g. `suggest_google`, `suggest_bing`, `related`, `question`.

trend.description: 12 months of `{ month, views }` when a demand signal exists.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes: skipped or rate-limited providers, missing setup.

est_volume.description: Estimated monthly searches; null when there is no basis for an estimate.

kd.description: Keyword difficulty 0–100; null until a SERP was analysed.

popularity.description: Relative popularity within this research (0–100). Not a search volume.

serp_features.description: Null until a SERP was analysed.

sources.description: Where the idea came from, e.g. `suggest_google`, `suggest_bing`, `related`, `question`.

trend.description: 12 months of `{ month, views }` when a demand signal exists.

popularity.description: Relative popularity from the research it was saved from; null for manual entries.

pinned.description: Pinned keywords are listed first. Default true.

detail.description: Human/agent readable explanation; often tells you what to do next.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the project's default market.

language_code.description: Language of the default market (ISO 639-1, optional region).

revision.description: Send this value as `revision` when updating. Stale updates are rejected.

needs_env.description: Needs something from the server operator (environment variable).

needs_key.description: Needs an API key from the user.

note.description: Honest note about data quality or terms.

message.description: What happened, phrased for a person.

has_key.description: An API key is stored (the key itself is never returned).

missing.description: What is missing before it can be used.

ready.description: Enabled and fully configured: research will use it.

position.description: Null = not in the first `depth` results at that time.

checked_at.description: Null when the keyword was never checked.

depth.description: Results examined in the latest check.

exact.description: True when the latest check used one search engine's real ranking.

position.description:
Latest position; null = not in the first `depth` results, or never checked
(see `checked_at`).

previous_position.description: Position in the check before the latest one.

url.description: Ranking URL in the latest check.

domain.description: Registrable domain whose positions are tracked.

hour_utc.description: Hour of day (UTC) of scheduled runs.

weekday.description: ISO weekday (1 = Monday) of weekly runs.

avg_position.description: Average position of the keywords that rank; null when none do.

project_position.description: Null means the project website was absent from this sampled results page.

registered_at.description: Registry's registration event, not the date the website first went online.

ids.description: Omit or pass an empty list to refresh all saved keywords. Otherwise 1–1000 IDs.

RunEstimate.description: What a check costs in provider requests (there are no credits or fees in SeoSeo itself).

est_seconds.description: Rough duration of one run given the provider's pacing; null without a provider.

note.description: What to do before a run can work, if anything.

provider.description: Provider that would be used first; null when none is set up.

runs_per_month.description: Scheduled runs in a 30-day month (0 for manual).

keywords.description: Or save keywords typed by hand (project market, no metrics yet).

research_id.description: Save ideas of this research (with their metrics)…

already_saved.description: Already saved before, so left unchanged.

html.description: A complete, self-contained HTML document. External scripts are rejected.

popularity.description: Relative popularity from the research it was saved from; null for manual entries.

authority_loaded.description: False until the Common Crawl ranks were imported (KD needs them).

cached.description: Served from the shared SERP cache.

exact.description: True when positions are one search engine's real ranking; false for a meta-search blend.

kd.description: Keyword difficulty 0–100; null without authority data or with fewer than 5 results.

provider.description: Provider that fetched the page, e.g. `serp_searxng`.

refresh.description: Fetch a fresh page instead of a cached one (cached pages are reused for 7 days).

shared_keywords.description: Keywords for which both the requested domain and this domain were observed.

sr.description:
SeoSeo Rank of the domain (0–100); null when it is outside the imported list or
no authority data is loaded.

baseline_audit_id.description: Required when enabling a schedule; frozen configuration is copied from this completed audit.

expected_revision.description: 0 for first save; otherwise the revision returned by GET.

token.description: Secret URL token. It is shown only when sharing is enabled.

invite_token.description: Token from an invitation link: joins that workspace even when sign-up is closed.

needs_setup.description: True when no account exists yet: the next sign-up becomes the instance admin.

delay_ms.description: Delay between requests per slot in ms (0–10000, default 250).

lighthouse.description: Run desktop Lighthouse lab audits (requires the renderer profile).

render_js.description: Audit the rendered DOM (requires the renderer profile).

respect_robots.description: Obey robots.txt (default true). Turn off only for sites you own.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; defaults to the project's market.

language.description: ISO 639-1; defaults to the project's market.

serp_top.description: Most popular ideas that also get a SERP analysis (0–30, default 10).

keyword_ids.description: Check only these keywords; omit for all.

url.description: Homepage URL or host; defaults to the project HTTPS homepage.

keywords.description: Latest position per keyword, pinned keywords first.

research_note.description: Optional immutable research-log entry appended by the server.

revision.description: Revision returned by the last GET. Use 0 for a context that has never been saved.

UpdateProjectInput.description: Partial update. Send `null` for nullable fields to clear them; omit to keep.

api_key.description: New API key. Send an empty string to remove the stored key; omit to keep it.

start_url.description: Optional root URL, useful for HTTP-only sites. Must match the project's host.

expected_domain.description: Website shown during review. Reject a save if the project website changed meanwhile.

key_pages.description: Selected evidence URLs only; preserve existing pages with the same URL.
